items.title: undefined-ui/second-brain-os
items.excerpt: An AI second brain that maintains itself. Full guide, starter vault, agent skills and scripts for a self-organizing knowledge base in Claude Code and Obsidian.
items.summary: undefined-ui/second-brain-os describes an AI second brain maintaining itself, offering a guide, starter vault, agent skills and scripts for self-organizing knowledge in Claude Code and Obsidian.
items.usefulness: Might enable building document analysis pipelines where AI agents autonomously organize and retrieve knowledge without manual taxonomy maintenance.
items.to_verify: How the knowledge base detects organizational decay, what triggers re-indexing, and whether it handles conflicting categorizations.
